meta.conceptLabel: Sunday Family Pop — 日本シニア低温ヒーリング再設計
meta.tempoPolicy: 62-66 BPM only. Never raise BPM to shorten duration.
meta.energyPolicy: Playlist-wide energy ceiling 2.2/5. No designated upbeat track, no big emotional high point, no sudden density jump, no full-band chorus blast.
meta.genrePolicy: Quiet 1970s Japanese New Music, soft Kayokyoku and acoustic Folk only. Motown, Philly Soul, funk, Showa Groove and dance-pop drive are removed.
meta.lyricPolicy: Metaphor-led poetic Japanese. No direct family-role narration, no explanatory emotional conclusion. Each song uses one central concrete image or object.
meta.vocalPolicy: Mature low-mid chest voices, calm neutral expression, narrow melodic range, almost straight tone, tiny delayed vibrato. No youthful brightness, smiley theatrical delivery, belt, falsetto climax, octave lift or shouted ad-lib.
meta.arrangementPolicy: Maximum four clearly audible primary instruments at once. Drums absent on most tracks; when present, only barely audible brushes.
meta.transitionPolicy: Track-to-track loudness, spectral brightness, vocal presence and arrangement density remain close. Choruses widen only 8-12% over verses.
meta.durationPolicy: 44-48 effective bars, compact three-scene lyric form, one 4-bar instrumental break, no long coda, no extra final refrain.
meta.revisionNoteKo: 원본의 76~98 BPM, Motown/Philly Soul, 가장 밝은 곡/큰 감정 고점 설계를 폐기하고, 001·002 최신 기준과 동일한 저에너지 일본 시니어 채널 문법으로 15곡 전체를 재작성했다.
